hints.title: Order Invariance
hints.text: Notice that pair sum is commutative, so sorting the elements does not affect the total count of fair pairs.

hints.title: Subproblem Reduction
hints.text: The count of pairs with sum between lower and upper equals the count of pairs with sum <= upper minus count with sum <= lower - 1.

hints.title: Monotonic Sum Counting
hints.text: In a sorted array, pairs summing to at most a target value can be counted in linear time using monotonic index progression.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Counting Implementation

variables: n: number of integers in nums
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); each two-pointer sweep takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all index pairs (i, j) requires O(n^2) time, which exceeds limits for n up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond input sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts the array and uses two pointers or binary search to count valid pairs.
